description: Delete one version of an application, to clean up test versions. Exactly one exact version name; refused while any deployment of that version is running. The container image stays in the registry (edgegap_delete_registry_tag removes it). Cannot be undone, so confirm with the developer when the version is not one this conversation created.

dry_run.description: Show the exact request (method, host, path, body) with secrets masked, and send nothing. Local checks still run. Use it to confirm a billable or destructive call before making it.

version.description: The exact version name to delete.
